verdict.rationale: There is no evidence of choosing a hosting region or data-residency location for Semgrep AppSec Platform, which receives CI findings for triage (semgrep-docs-45). The only relevant control is keeping data local: analysis runs on your machine or build environment and code is not uploaded by default (semgrep-gh-2), scans need no login (semgrep-docs-34), and --dry-run stops results going to the web app (semgrep-docs-33). Missing for 10: selectable cloud regions (e.g. EU/US), data-residency documentation for stored findings and platform data, self-hosted/on-prem platform option, and independent corroboration.
